description: Issues a brand-new API key for this account and permanently invalidates the current one. IMPORTANT, irreversible tradeoff: signing in again (GitHub, Google, Microsoft, or Clio) will no longer recover this account afterward — only use this when the caller has explicitly confirmed they understand that and will save the new key themselves (e.g. they suspect the current key leaked).

confirm.description: Must be exactly true. Regenerating permanently and irreversibly breaks GitHub-login recovery for this account — only set true after explicitly telling the user that consequence and getting their confirmation, not on a vague or ambiguous request.

name: regenerate_api_key
